description: This file implements the SQLite backend storage adapter for a telemetry system. It manages database schema initialization, asset and telemetry data storage, alert handling, and provides utility functions for date/time conversions. The class `SQLiteStorageAdapter` encapsulates the database interactions, including creating, querying, and updating assets, telemetry records, and alerts.

classes.name: SQLiteStorageAdapter
classes.description: A storage adapter implementing data persistence using SQLite for assets, telemetry, and alerts.
